planner_vs_deterministic_baseline.description: GPT-5.4 planner recommended_tool, prompt-level majority vote across 3 repeats, vs. the repository's existing deterministic _fallback_plan() baseline, on the same 120 supported prompts. NOT the same comparison as planner-vs-router agreement/McNemar (see analysis/agreement.py).
